Identified as this saint because: A photograph Commons describes «Ο Άγιος Εφραίμ ο Κατουνακιώτης, την δεκαετία του 1920, λίγο πριν μονάσει στον Άγιον Όρος» and files under its category 'Ephraim of Katounakia' beside 'Athonite saints' — the saint of Katounakia in the 1920s, shortly before he took the habit on Athos. The epithet Κατουνακιώτης is the identification and is this folder's own, and the elder of Katounakia who reposed in 1998 is the only saint who carries it. Commons' category holds five files and only two show the man; the other, from his first years as a monk, was passed over because Commons holds it at 134 px. Commons describes it: Ο Άγιος Εφραίμ ο Κατουνακιώτης, την δεκαετία του 1920, λίγο πριν μονάσει στον Άγιον Όρος
